properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “Import one design into another and analyse the whole”
properties.question: You want to pull a dependency's design into your own and then run reflow2's normal checks over both together. reflow2 cannot do that yet: loading one design into another overwrites anything sharing a name, because that loader was built for reloading a design onto itself. Making both sit side by side is real work — do you want it, and does it come before the connection-details work or after?
